purpose: `%` used as an operator in an HSPICE expression is refused, since HSPICE documents no `%` operator.

oracle.derivation: HSPICE Quick Reference Guide U-2003.03 (cse.chalmers.se/~perla/ugrad/EDA351/HSPICEQuickRef.pdf), Algebraic Expressions: "In addition to simple arithmetic operations (+, -, *, /)" it lists functions only, no % operator. Star-Hspice Manual, Release 1998.2, ch. 3 (class.ece.uw.edu/cadta/hspice/chapter_3.pdf) p. 3-18 lists % among the characters a name may contain, so '10 % 3' is no valid expression.
oracle.confirmed_reason: No second simulator reads the HSPICE dialect: Xyce -hspice-ext is Xyce's own extension, not HSPICE; the manuals are the oracle.
